Product Details: The DongCheng DCPB1288 Cordless Brushless Impact Wrench is a heavy-duty powerhouse built for railway maintainers, truck repairers, and professional mechanics who demand serious performance. Powered by a 20V Max Lithium-Ion battery, its brushless motor delivers up to 1288 N.m of fastening torque and an impressive 1700 N.m of nut-busting torque, making even the most stubborn fasteners no match. The 3-speed and torque adjustment system provides excellent control over output speed and torque, with no-load speeds ranging from 1200 to 1700 RPM across gears. Weighing just 3 kg (without battery), the lightweight body reduces fatigue during extended use. The smart loosen mode prevents nuts from dropping accidentally, while the new DVR technology minimises vibration for added comfort. A durable aluminium gear housing, premium rubberised grip, and built-in LED work light round out this feature-packed tool. Includes two 5.0Ah batteries and a fast charger for minimal downtime. Square drive size: 19 mm (3/4"). Standard bolt size: M12–M33.
